description: Shared Renovate policy for ShaddyDC's projects (README.md).

packageRules.description: Non-major updates merge themselves once the PR's CI passes. Renovate never automerges without passing checks, so a repo without PR CI only gets PRs.
GitHub Actions majors too: the PR's own CI runs the new action.

ghcr.io and other OCI registries publish no release timestamps; without this every update from them waits forever. The price: the cooldown only applies to Docker Hub images (the one registry Renovate reads push times from).

Renovate cannot hold back crates inside cargo update, so Cargo lock maintenance would pull versions minutes old. It opens PRs without merging them until Cargo's own min-publish-age (stable in Rust 1.100, 2026-11-12) is set in each repo's .cargo/config.toml. npm gets --before from Renovate; pnpm and uv repos set the cooldown in their own config.
Our own images, actions and packages skip the cooldown: we publish them, and what goes into them already passed it in their own repos.
